request: Add a decorator in CTFd utils that redirects non-logged-in users to the registration page instead of login.

summary.result_text:
I added `authed_or_register` to `CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py`, right after `authed_only`. I haven't run it or any tests.

It copies `authed_only`, with one difference. Non-logged-in users are redirected to `auth.register` instead of `auth.login`, and the original page is kept in the `next` parameter. JSON and event-stream requests still get a 403, as they do with `authed_only`.

I didn't apply it to any routes. To use it, import it from `CTFd.utils.decorators` and put `@authed_or_register` on a view.

I didn't check whether the register view handles `next` after sign-up. If it doesn't, users will land on the default page after registering instead of the one they were trying to reach.
